agileRanger: Suppresses Opening Volley and Ranged Evasion while worn.
agileRogue: Suppresses Cunning Action and Uncanny Dodge while worn.
heavyRage: Heavy armor — ends your Rage (no fury bonuses while worn).
monkWeaponKeepsKit: A monk weapon — your Ki, Flurry, and stances flow whether it's in hand or you fight bare-handed. The only trade is the strike itself: this weapon's die, enchantment, and affixes in hand, against your bare hands' larger {die} +{edge} and no gear.
monkWeaponStillsKit: Not a monk weapon — take it up and the forms fall silent: no Ki, no Flurry, no stances, and your bare hands' {die} +{edge} sets aside with them. Fight bare-handed to keep the whole kit; hold this and you're only a body with a blade.
fistsNotAnItem: The empty hand is not an item — it never leaves.
